method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: search_apps
tools.title: Search apps
tools.description: Free-text search over app listings on one store, returning a ranked list. Use this when you have a name or a phrase. To select apps by revenue, downloads, category or rating instead, use filter_apps, which is far more precise.

q.description: Word or phrase to search for.

published.description: Restrict to published listings. Omit for all.

country.description: Storefront as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Defaults to US.

language.description: Metadata language as a locale, e.g. en_US.

fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return; omit for all. This surface REJECTS the filter-only names (downloads_month, downloads_lifetime, downloads_daily, downloads_exact, downloads_mark, revenue_month, revenue_lifetime) with HTTP 400 naming the field; reach for filter_apps when you need one of them. The equivalents here are `downloads` and `revenue`. `installs`, `installs_exact` and `review_count` are Google Play only and 400 on the App Store.

sort.description: Comma-separated fields; a leading `-` sorts descending, e.g. `-downloads_month`.

tools.name: get_app
tools.title: Get app
tools.description: Full listing for one app. The id is the bundle id on Google Play (com.twitter.android) and the numeric App Store id on iOS (333903271).

id.description: Bundle id on Google Play, numeric id on the App Store.

country.description: Storefront as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Defaults to US.

language.description: Metadata language as a locale, e.g. en_US.

fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return; omit for all. This surface REJECTS the filter-only names (downloads_month, downloads_lifetime, downloads_daily, downloads_exact, downloads_mark, revenue_month, revenue_lifetime) with HTTP 400 naming the field; reach for filter_apps when you need one of them. The equivalents here are `downloads` and `revenue`. `installs`, `installs_exact` and `review_count` are Google Play only and 400 on the App Store.

tools.name: filter_apps
tools.title: Filter apps
tools.description: Search apps by structured criteria: revenue, downloads, rating, category, developer, release and update dates, countries of availability. This is the main market-research tool and the one to reach for over search_apps whenever the question is about a segment rather than a name.

filter.description: Structured filter object. Numeric fields take {"gte": n, "lte": n} and date fields take {"gte": "YYYY-MM-DD", "lte": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. Common keys: name, category, category_type (APP|GAME), developer, developer_id, downloads_month, revenue_month, rating_avg, rating_count, review_count, release_date, update_date, active_countries, iap, published. Note that downloads_month and revenue_month are expressed in thousands.

fields.description: Field names to return; omit for all. This surface accepts every field the GET tools accept, plus the filter-only names (downloads_month, downloads_lifetime, downloads_daily, downloads_exact, downloads_mark, revenue_month, revenue_lifetime). `downloads_mark` is Google Play only.

sort.description: Comma-separated fields; a leading `-` sorts descending, e.g. `-downloads_month`.

country.description: Storefront as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Defaults to US.

language.description: Metadata language as a locale, e.g. en_US.

tools.name: summarize_apps
tools.title: Summarise apps
tools.description: Aggregate totals for every app matching a filter, without returning the apps. Use this first to size a segment: it answers 'how many apps and how much revenue' in one call, where paging through filter_apps would cost many.

filter.description: Structured filter object. Numeric fields take {"gte": n, "lte": n} and date fields take {"gte": "YYYY-MM-DD", "lte": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. Common keys: name, category, category_type (APP|GAME), developer, developer_id, downloads_month, revenue_month, rating_avg, rating_count, review_count, release_date, update_date, active_countries, iap, published. Note that downloads_month and revenue_month are expressed in thousands.

q.description: Optional free-text term to narrow the set.

tools.name: get_similar_apps
tools.title: Get similar apps
tools.description: Apps the store lists as similar to a given app. `link` set to `to` returns what the store shows on this app's page; `from` reverses the question and returns the apps that list this one as similar to them, which is how you find who is competing for its audience.

link.description: `to` for this app's similar list, `from` for apps that list this one.

filter.description: Structured filter object. Numeric fields take {"gte": n, "lte": n} and date fields take {"gte": "YYYY-MM-DD", "lte": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. Common keys: name, category, category_type (APP|GAME), developer, developer_id, downloads_month, revenue_month, rating_avg, rating_count, review_count, release_date, update_date, active_countries, iap, published. Note that downloads_month and revenue_month are expressed in thousands.

tools.name: get_app_reviews
tools.title: Get app reviews
tools.description: User reviews for one app. Reviews are storefront- and language-specific, so country and language change which set comes back rather than just how it is rendered.

id.description: Bundle id on Google Play, numeric id on the App Store.

language.description: Metadata language as a locale, e.g. en_US.

country.description: Storefront as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Defaults to US.

sort.description: Comma-separated fields; a leading `-` sorts descending, e.g. `-downloads_month`.

tools.name: get_rankings
tools.title: Get chart rankings
tools.description: Chart positions over a date range, one row per app per chart per day. A chart is the triple (country, category, collection), plus platform on the App Store.

tools.name: search_developers
tools.title: Search developers
tools.description: Free-text search over developers. The query also accepts `field:value` terms, for example `hq_country:US`.

q.description: Free text, or `field:value` such as hq_country:US.

fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return; omit for all. The equivalents here are `downloads` and `revenue`. `installs`, `installs_exact` and `review_count` are Google Play only and 400 on the App Store.

sort.description: Comma-separated fields; a leading `-` sorts descending, e.g. `-downloads_month`.

tools.name: get_developer

tools.description: One developer record, including publisher identifiers and headquarters country.

tools.name: filter_developers

tools.name: get_app_estimates
tools.title: Get download and revenue estimates
tools.description: Download and revenue estimates for one or more apps over a date range.

id.description: One app id, or several separated by commas.

tools.name: get_keyword_suggestions
tools.title: Get keyword suggestions
tools.description: Google Play search autocomplete for a term. Answers 202 with a partial result while a fresh crawl runs, so call again shortly for the complete set.

country.description: Storefront as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Defaults to US.

lang.description: Metadata language as a locale, e.g. en_US.

freshness.description: How stale a cached result may be before it is recrawled.

tools.name: get_liveops_events
tools.title: Get LiveOps events
tools.description: LiveOps events Google Play shows on an app listing: sales, tournaments, updates and new content. Answers 202 while a fresh crawl runs.

country.description: Storefront as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Defaults to US.

freshness.description: How stale a cached result may be before it is recrawled.

tools.name: get_app_listing
tools.title: Get app listing
tools.description: The Google Play store listing of one app for a country and language exactly as Google Play serves it: title, short and full description, what's new, icon, feature graphic, trailer and screenshots. Accepts any Google Play Console locale, not only the languages get_app stores, so use it for localized metadata such as Indonesian, Thai or Portuguese (Portugal). The listing is crawled on demand and kept; answers 202 while the crawl runs, so call again shortly. `translated` is true when Google Play shows a machine translation because the developer has not supplied that language.

country.description: Storefront as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Defaults to US.

language.description: Listing language as a Google Play Console locale, e.g. id, th, pt_PT, es_ES.

freshness.description: How old a kept listing may be before it is crawled again.

wait.description: Wait for a running crawl (default) or answer 202 right away.
